meaning: From consistent assumptions, PLG never derives a cycle of strict partial ground of any finite length, nor a strict ground together with its weak reversal; on finitely many atoms derivable strict ground is well-founded. The proof composes the derived Transitivity(≺/≺) of PLG-DERIVED-RULES with Non-Circularity and Mathlib's finite well-foundedness of strict orders (classical). Consistency of the assumptions is a hypothesis, not established; nothing is said about actual ground.
